firstHarnessShapeCorrection.reason: The development harness initially read totalTokens from the outer Rust receipt instead of ledgerRow. Source behavior was unchanged. The final harness checks the returned ledger row and unchanged ledger bytes.

usageCases: Two actual local SSE streams decoded by the existing OpenAI-compatible provider record two observations and one canonical 30-token stream row including 3 cached tokens. Rust's same-id ledger call returns the original row and leaves ledger bytes unchanged.

A real socket teardown after a streamed 8-token usage record persists the known amount and unknown state before retry. The successful request brings known usage to 17. A forced append-open error after index update leaves the original transaction, and retry completes exactly one bill without incrementing lifetime twice.
A provider response without usage increments the physical attempt and retains unknown, with no synthetic zero billing row.
An external model metadata edit retains actual observed usage and blocks the next physical request while keeping the external edit.
An actual compaction summary and the agent request both contribute to durable usage. Only the agent's observed input defines context capacity.
A billing failure during actual compaction cannot be consumed by its structural fallback as permission to send another model request.
isolatedCandidate.limits: The approved owned Store was bound through an isolated Host to the production TUI model adapter and a controlled loopback SSE peer. No live production Host or real external service was used. Usage settlement remains separate from actual resource stop, crash recovery, and installed upgrade compatibility.
